messages:
Amanda: Quick sync — we need to lock scope for the Live Insights launch (dashboards + tracing hooks + cost breakdown + error analytics). Customer asks bumped this up. TL;DR: what do we cut for v1?
Priya: For customers, the killer is per-route token cost + top-n expensive calls. They keep asking for token attribution to features.
Jack: Agree. From infra side: full tracing at request-level is expensive. Can we start with lightweight span hooks + sampling? :thinking_face:
Zach: Error analytics: customers want grouped root causes (fingerprints) + small stack traces. We can do exception fingerprinting without full traces.
Amanda: Proposal: must-have = dashboards (cost + latency heatmap), route-level cost breakdown, error grouping. Nice-to-have = full distributed traces, per-call KV cache view.
Priya: Must-have for customers: ability to filter cost by model, route, and time window. Also a CSV export.
Jack: Implementation note: to get route-level cost we need token attribution from runtime. That means we need a small header added to requests so billing can attribute at ingest. Will require a runtime tag.
Amanda: Ok. So launch criteria draft: 1) dashboards with route/model/time filters 2) cost breakdown by route & model 3) basic tracing hooks: span start/stop + sample id 4) error grouping with fingerprinting 5) docs & export
Zach: On rollouts: start with 10% of traffic for traces to validate pipeline. Errors & cost dashboards can be across 100% as they are cheaper.
Priya: Ops ask: we need an estimate of SLO impact & egress cost. Jack, can you ballpark ingest and storage for 30-day retention?
Jack: Rough numbers: sampled traces (10%) -> ~0.5-1 GB/day per 100k reqs. Metrics + dashboards + cost counters -> ~200-300 MB/day. Storage cost small compared to trace ingest.
Amanda: Tradeoffs for v1: no continuous trace storage beyond sampled windows. Full traces will be archived on demand.
Priya: UX: dashboards should surface anomalies (spikes in cost or errors) and allow linking into a trace when available.
Zach: For error fingerprinting, we'll use a hashing approach on exception type + top stack frame + message pattern. Works for both sync and async errors.
Jack: Runtime change (minimal): add `x-rw-route-id` header; runtime emits span hooks only when `trace-sample=true` header present. Example snippet:
```
# runtime config
trace_hooks:
  enabled: true
  sampler: header_based
  sample_header: trace-sample
```
Amanda: Nice. Who owns infra + docs? Priya for product docs, Jack for runtime changes, Zach for error analytics algorithm. I'll own dashboards.
Priya: Customer comms: I'll draft a short note outlining launch limits and roadmap for full traces.
Jack: I'll schedule a quick infra spike to add header + sampler. ETA: 3 days for spike, 2 sprints for end-to-end.
Zach: I'll prototype fingerprinting on a small dataset this week.
deploy-bot: new ticket created: OBS-3412 - Live Insights v1 scope.
Amanda: Action items: Priya -> comms draft, Jack -> spike + cost numbers, Zach -> fingerprint prototype, Amanda -> dashboard mocks. Check back EOD Friday? :calendar:
Priya: EOD Friday works. I’ll ping customer champions with the plan afterwards. :thumbsup:
Jack: Starting spike today. Will post logs in this thread.
Zach: Prototype ready Wednesday.
Amanda: Thanks all. Keeping v1 tight reduces ingest cost and lets us iterate. :rocket:
